cohort: 401 women previously operated for pelvic organ prolapse (POP) and/or stress urinary incontinence (SUI) and 233 age and body mass index (BMI)-matched controls operated for benign gynecologic reasons without POP or SUI
finding: Grand_multiparity increased the risk of both POP/SUI surgery and POP surgery, while vaginal birth increased the risk of POP/SUI surgery.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth increased the risk of requiring surgery for pelvic organ prolapse and/or stress urinary incontinence.
